events.message: Firing: CheckoutLatencyHigh — p99 latency > 2s for 5m (checkout-api, prod-us)
Acknowledged page. Dashboard shows latency spike starting ~13:58, error rate still < 0.1%.
checkout-api v2.14.3 deployed to prod-us at 13:57 by CI pipeline (commit 9f3ac21).
v2.14.3 changed pricing-cache TTL from 300s to 30s. Cache hit ratio dropped 98% -> 41%. Looks like a cache stampede on the pricing DB.
Rolled back to v2.14.2. Latency recovering.
Status page updated: incident resolved, ~27 min of degraded checkout latency, no failed payments observed.
